blocks.raw: # Slab Change Log Standard Export Template
blocks.text: Slab Change Log Standard Export Template

blocks.raw: The slab change log template is based on the **slab\_change\_log** fact.
blocks.text: The slab change log template is based on the slab_change_log fact.

blocks.raw: This template lets you export the entire slab history of the customer. You can also get the slab change in a specific duration.
blocks.text: This template lets you export the entire slab history of the customer. You can also get the slab change in a specific duration.

blocks.raw:
| Measure                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Auto Update Time Slab Upgrade | Date and time when the slab upgrade table is available at the source was last updated. It is in the Unix timestamp format.                                                                                                    |
| Event Date Time               | Date and time in Unix timestamp when a slab is changed                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Event Source Id               | Unique id of the event source.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Notes                         | Reason why the slab is changed.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Slab Name                     | Name of the slab or tier.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| User Id                       | Unique id of a customer.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Id                            | Unique id of slab upgrade history table.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Repeat Status.                | Indicates whether a transaction is a repeat sale for the customer. This KPI uses standardized logic based on the repeat\_status field and includes all slabs. The logic is now aligned across both export and report outputs. |
